instruction:
Use ZRemesher to retopologize the opened `scene.obj`. Before starting the work, open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. It contains one OBJ object/group named Head with four face groups: EyeSocketGuide, LipGuide, NoseGuide, and Body. The named boundaries are not automatically ZRemesher curves. Either use Frame Mesh to turn the relevant group boundaries into real guide curves and set Curve Strength to at least 60, or enable Keep Groups so the named boundaries are preserved directly. Target about 10,000 faces and export `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`.

The output must contain exactly one object/group named Head, 9,000 to 11,000 faces, at least 95% quads, exactly the four named face groups, and a manifold mesh in which every edge is shared by two faces.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
